name: Touch of Weakness
label: Quest
description: Touch of Weakness: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My respect to you and your kind, friend. I normally teach only those of my own tribe. Your lessons come from Aelthalyste in the city once called Lordaeron.
You should return to her if you're to learn those abilities that set you apart from other faiths.
Go to the War Quarter in the Undercity and find your mistress there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, good, another has arrived. Time may not matter to me, but to you it is of the essence. There is much for you to learn and there is much I wish to teach you. You simply must prove your worth. Do that, and you shall be greatly rewarded.
